🪄 OpenSesh

Open sesame for your OpenCode sessions.
Brought to you by a panda who knows a little magic. 🐼

You have 400 sessions. Half of them are called "New session". One of them is just you typing `helo`. We don't judge. We just clean up. 🧹 ![The OpenSesh window: three open tabs on top, sessions grouped by day below, and a preview of the current one](https://gitlab.com/reza-marandi/opensesh/-/raw/main/docs/screenshot.png) Sessions made up. The panda's real ones are a mess. ## 🎉 1.0 is here OpenSesh moved in with OpenCode. It's a plugin now, so there's no dashboard to run and no browser tab to babysit. Press `ctrl+s` anywhere and every session from every project pops up over whatever you're doing. - 🗃️ Your open tabs sit on top, and `ctrl+w` closes the ones you're done with - 🔎 Search, filter by project or age, sort ten ways, then delete or archive a whole pile at once - 🧟 Purge spots the sessions you started by accident: typos, `/quit`, empty ones. You decide what goes. - 💾 See what each session weighs, and vacuum the database to get the space back - 📐 Happy in a narrow terminal too ## 📥 Install Needs OpenCode 2.1 or newer. ```bash opencode plugin add opencode-opensesh opencode service restart ``` Reopen OpenCode and press `ctrl+s`. `/sesh` and `l` work too. ## ⌨️ Keys Typing searches. Everything else is a `ctrl` key, and the window shows them at the bottom. | Key | Does | | ----------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------ | | `↑` `↓` `enter` | move, open | | `tab` `shift+↑↓` `ctrl+a` | select one, a range, or everything shown | | `ctrl+r` `ctrl+d` `ctrl+e` | rename, delete, archive | | `ctrl+w` | close the tab | | `ctrl+f` `ctrl+t` `ctrl+v` `ctrl+g` | filter by project, sub-agents, archived, age | | `ctrl+o` | sort | | `ctrl+k` | more: purge, disk space, copy the resume command | | `esc` | back out, then close | ## ⚙️ Options ```json { "plugins": [ { "package": "opencode-opensesh", "options": { "keybind": "ctrl+s,l", "animations": true, "purge": { "maxMessages": 6, "shortPrompt": 12, "idleMinutes": 15 } } } ] } ``` That goes in `~/.config/opencode/opencode.json`. `keybind` can be `false`, `animations: false` stops the spinner, and `purge` tunes what counts as a mistake. ## 🤔 Is it safe? Renames, archives and deletes all go through OpenCode's own API. Sizes come from a read-only peek at the database. The only thing OpenSesh writes itself is a vacuum, and only when you ask. Still, deleted is deleted. Be cool. 😎 ## 🐍 Coming from 0.x? The old Python dashboard is retired. Stop it and uninstall it the way you installed it: ```bash opensesh stop brew uninstall opensesh && brew untap reza-marandi/opensesh # or: uv tool uninstall opensesh / pipx uninstall opensesh ``` ## 🛠️ Hacking `bun install && bun run check`, then `bun scripts/sandbox.ts` for a throwaway OpenCode full of fake sessions. To run your checkout in your own OpenCode, link it as a local plugin: `ln -s "$PWD/dev" ~/.config/opencode/plugins/opensesh`. What changed in each version is on the [releases page](https://gitlab.com/reza-marandi/opensesh/-/releases). ## 📄 License MIT. Do what you want, just don't blame me for the session you really needed. 🫡
